$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Sessions and Phone access settings: what this Mac does while agents work and for your phone. gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants (both lists parse into SessionSettings). Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: sessions
lists.note: Settings > Agents > Sessions: this Mac's behavior while agent sessions run (SessionSettings).

rows.note: Idle system sleep stays off while a local agent works (KeepAwakeService). The display can still sleep, and closing the lid still sleeps the Mac.

title.text: Keep Mac Awake While Agents Work

help.text: Stops idle sleep while an agent on this Mac is working. Your display can still turn off, and closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

choices.note: The Mac sleeps on its usual schedule.
Only while the Mac runs on power from an adapter.

rows.name: resumeAgents
rows.note: On: a terminal brought back after a crash or restart runs its agent's resume (claude --resume <id>, codex resume <id>) at the new shell's empty prompt. Off, or a settings file that does not parse: nothing runs, and the restored line shows the command. The daemon reads it at each respawn (cmux-tui-util user_settings::resume_agents). Commands other than agents never run again.

help.text: Terminal agents reopen their session after a crash or restart.

rows.name: allowFullAccess
rows.note: Off: AgentPaneTransport refuses session/set_mode and the mode config option into a mode that skips approvals (AgentPaneModeConfirmation.isFullAccess, the picker's warning-color rule). On by default: today's behavior, and Lawrence 2026-10-07 (no sheet for full access).

help.text: Off, cmux won't switch an agent into a mode that skips approvals.

rows.name: promptSuggestions
rows.note: Agents get the cmux-sessions MCP tools (ACPMUX_OFFER_TOOLS=1, read at each acpmux daemon start) and the pages show their suggested tasks (AgentPaneSuggestedTasks). On by default, as the Debug toggle agent.suggestedTasks was (Leo 2026-10-19); off here turns them off. That toggle is now off by default and only forces them on.

help.text: Agents can suggest next tasks, which you start as child chats beside the current one. Agents started after the change get it.

lists.name: phone
lists.note: Settings > Accounts > Phone Access: whether phones signed in to your cmux account reach this Mac and what they may do (PhoneAccessGate, MobileHostService). The transport (Iroh today) is not part of any key.

rows.name: allowConnections
rows.note: Off: the phone listener does not run and no phone reaches this Mac. Off on a fresh install; a Mac that already served phones keeps it on (PhoneAccessMigration).

title.text: Let Your Phone Use This Mac

help.text: So your phone can find this Mac, cmux registers with its servers this Mac's name, device ID and platform, the app's bundle ID, version and build channel, the Mac's relay address and connection key, and your account and team IDs. Workspace names, folders, full paths and terminal output go only over the encrypted link to your phone. None of that, and no branch name or repo URL, is sent to cmux servers. Exception: while “Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off” is on, cmux servers store each workspace's ID, resource ID, short ID, name, name revision, group, color, icon, pinned state, unread mark, unread count and whether it is active.

rows.name: startSessions
rows.note: Off: phones may view, type into and answer existing workspaces and agents, but not create workspaces or terminals (compat RPC and daemon lanes alike).

title.text: Let Your Phone Start New Workspaces

help.text: Off, your phone can still follow, type into and answer what's already running.

rows.name: phoneKeepAwake
rows.note: Idle system sleep stays off while phone access is on and the listener runs (KeepAwakeService). A sleeping Mac is unreachable until it wakes.

title.text: Keep Mac Awake for Your Phone

help.text: A sleeping Mac can't be reached from your phone until it wakes. Closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

choices.note: The Mac sleeps on its usual schedule.
Only while the Mac runs on power from an adapter.

rows.name: cloudReplica
rows.note: On: the daemon publishes a narrow copy of this Mac's workspace list to the Cloud service (cloud-host-replica-v1, plans/cmux-next/object-sync/DESIGN.md phase 3), so a phone reads it while the Mac is offline and renames through it while the Mac is online. Off: the copy is deleted (replica.purge) and nothing is published. Opt-in until the default is decided (#13742).

title.text: Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off

help.text: cmux stores this Mac's workspace names, colors and unread counts so your phone can show them while the Mac is off. A workspace name can be a folder's name. No paths, tab titles or terminal output. Turning this off deletes the copy.

rows.name: cloudDesktop
rows.note: On: a paired phone's Chief info page shows the screen of this account's own running Cloud machine, view only (cloud-desktop-v1, cmux-next-ios/PROTOCOL.md `surface`): this Mac reads the machine's desktop over its Cloud tunnel and streams it to the phone. Off: the Mac lists no Cloud desktop to phones and hostd refuses one. Opt-in until the default is decided (#13742).

title.text: Show Your Cloud Machine's Screen on Your Phone

help.text: Your phone's Chief page shows your running Cloud machine's screen, view only. This Mac streams it while the page is open.
